records.text: Federal disclosures describe Show Faith by Works as carrying out the largest Christian church geofencing campaign in U.S. history, and identify Chad Jonson Schnitger as running the company.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: According to newly filed federal disclosures, the documents filed last week under the FARA Act reveal that Show Faith by Works LLC will execute what it bills as the, quote, largest Christian church geofencing campaign in U.S. history. ... A newly formed company with a San Diego address, Show Faith by Works, is run by Chad Schnitzger, a prominent Christian conservative activist in California.

verification.notes: FARA Exhibit AB uses the quoted superlative for the proposed campaign, and the registration materials and contemporaneous reporting identify Chad Jonson Schnitger as the founder and person leading Show Faith by Works. The wording largest is the registrant own billing, not an independently measured record.

sources.relevance: Primary filing contains the largest-campaign language and company materials.
